featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an excellent experience with Universal waterproofing. Mr Deep is extremely professional and completed the work within the committed timeline in fact, the job was finished ahead of schedule.
Since I was out of station during the work, Mr Deep handled the complete purchase of materials on my behalf and shared multiple options with me before proceeding, which I really appreciated. Mr Deep's communication was clear and transparent throughout.
Once the work was completed, the team ensured the house was properly cleaned and all debris was cleared, which shows their attention to detail and professionalism.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We were actually suffering from this leakage issue from past 5 to 6 years.
Did tried lot of ways to overcome this problem but we couldn't able to get the exact solution for this problem.
Then one day we came accross this company called Universal Waterproofing and we came in contact with Mr Deep Jhaveri
He personally came for the inspection and under his supervision his team did the whole terrace waterproofing work for us. The whole work got completed before mansoon by 1st week of May 2021 and we couldn't have any issues of water leakage from surface/terrace.
Also the best part is we do got 5 years warranty along with the certificate from Universal Waterproofing Co.
Thank you for all your efforts and work done by you guys.

featured_reviews.name: VIINOY AMIN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Podium ceiling slab and expansion joint waterproofing by PU Injection Grouting and Gel Injection Grouting.

We were having continuous water leakage in podium ceiling at multiple patches and expansion joint of podium during rains.

We treated the slab from the top side from open to sky side but still it use to leak heavily.

Finally we got it treated from negative side by PU and Gel Injection Grouting from Mr. Deep Jhaveri Universal Waterproofing Works and finally we got it sorted.

Treatment was done during rains in 2022 and till date there is no leakage.

It leaked little from expansion joint may be due to the continuous vehicle movement over it but Universal and team got it rectified on a single call to them.

I recommend Universal Waterproofing Works for the related issues.
